title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-11-17
content:
Release Engineering - Meeting Notes
Date: 2026-11-17
Time: 10:00-11:00 PT
Location: Zoom / #release-engineering
Facilitator: Ava Chen
Attendees: Ava Chen, Miguel Torres, Priya Nair, Samir Patel, Jules Martin, Erin Zhao (SRE guest)

Agenda:
1) Current release train status (v1.13.x -> v1.14.0)
2) Hotfix review and postmortem follow-ups (incident 2026-11-15)
3) Changelog and customer communication cadence
4) Blocking deps and infra capacity for next week
5) Action items & next meeting

Notes:
1) Release train status
- v1.13.x: Stable. Last hotfix v1.13.1 deployed 2026-11-16 to address degraded routing that caused increased 5xxs for Dedicated customers. HOTFIX-129 tracked the incident; PR #4123 merged and rolled out.
- v1.14.0 (next train): Target freeze for features -> 2026-11-20 EOD; soft cutoff for non-critical bugfixes 2026-11-22 12:00 PT. Scheduled integration testing window: 2026-11-23 to 2026-11-24. GA rollout window: 2026-11-24 18:00 PT -> 2026-11-30 (staged rollouts by customer tier).
- Feature callouts planned for v1.14.0: improved KV cache eviction heuristics (PR #4132), BPE tokenizer update (internal model infra change), and batching scheduler tweak to reduce p99 latency on short sequences.

2) Hotfix review / postmortem follow-ups (incident 2026-11-15)
- Summary: A routing table race during autoscaler event led to ~12 minutes of misrouted traffic resulting in elevated 5xxs for some Dedicated pods. Root cause: concurrent update path in smart-routing service not guarded by optimistic lock; repro path captured in REL-3421.
- Immediate remediation: rolled back autoscale policy change, deployed PR #4123 which adds locking and a small latency-safe debounce on route updates.
- Customer impact: 3 Dedicated customers experienced degraded latency and occasional 5xxs; CS notifications sent on 2026-11-15 evening with follow-up 2026-11-16 after hotfix.
- Follow-ups / owners:
  * Samir - finalize postmortem doc and add timeline + metrics (due 2026-11-19) [REL-3421].
  * Miguel - add integration test that simulates concurrent routing updates in the CI cluster (due 2026-11-26).
  * Erin (SRE) & Priya - propose improved autoscaler throttling heuristics and a canary policy for config changes (due 2026-11-24).

3) Changelog and customer comms
- Changelog draft for v1.13.1 and upcoming v1.14.0 created in Confluence linked above.
- Communications plan: short incident note for 2026-11-15 (posted), customer-facing release notes for v1.14.0 to be drafted by Product - deadline 2026-11-22. PR for documentation updates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4132 (WIP).
- Action: Jules to coordinate release notes and verify breaking-change flags by 2026-11-21.

4) Blocking dependencies / infra capacity
- Capacity: GPU pool reservation for integration tests on 2026-11-23 confirmed (region: us-west-2). However spike capacity for staged rollout is limited the week of 11/24 due to partner workloads - product to approve burst window or we stagger rollouts across regions.
- External deps: tokenizer team still finalizing BPE model weights; blocking-only-if-critical. If not ready by 11/20, we will ship v1.14.0 without tokenizer change and follow with a patch.
- Action: Ava to confirm burst capacity approval with infra by 2026-11-18.

5) Misc / operational items
- Change log hygiene: enforce PR template requires a one-line changelog and impact tag. Miguel will add a CI check that verifies CHANGELOG.md entries for release PRs (due 2026-11-25).
- Rollback plan for v1.14.0: automated rollback job to revert traffic to v1.13.x within 10 minutes if 5xx rate or p99 latency cross thresholds. Samir to test rollback runbook in staging on 2026-11-22.

Decisions:
- Keep freeze date for features at 2026-11-20; non-critical bugfixes allowed until 2026-11-22 noon.
- Proceed with staged rollout across tiers to minimize blast radius; no global switch until Nov 30 if metrics stable.

Action Items (owner - due):
- Samir Patel - Postmortem + timeline (REL-3421) - 2026-11-19.
- Miguel Torres - Integration test for concurrent routing updates - 2026-11-26.
- Priya Nair & Erin Zhao - Autoscaler throttling proposal & canary policy - 2026-11-24.
- Jules Martin - Draft v1.14.0 release notes + verify breaking-change flags - 2026-11-21.
- Ava Chen - Confirm burst capacity with infra for staged rollout - 2026-11-18.
- Miguel Torres - CI changelog enforcement check - 2026-11-25.
- Samir Patel - Test automated rollback job in staging - 2026-11-22.

Changelog summary (for internal review):
- v1.13.1 (hotfix) - Fix race in smart-routing updates; add debounce + lock; mitigates 5xx spike during autoscaler events.
- v1.14.0 (planned) - KV cache eviction heuristics, batching scheduler improvements, optional tokenizer update, and smaller perf fixes.

Risks / open questions:
- If tokenizer weights are delayed, will shipping without them cause customer regressions? Prod to assess risk by 11/20.
- Capacity constraint for staged rollout in us-west-2 could force region-by-region rollout and delay GA; need infra confirmation.
- Are there additional clients using pinned v1.13.x config that require early notification? CS to identify by 2026-11-18.

Next meeting: 2026-11-24 10:00 PT (focus: pre-release checklist & rollback test results)

Attachments / Links referenced:
- REL-3421 (postmortem draft)
- HOTFIX-129 (hotfix ticket)
- PR #4123 - routing fix (merged)
- PR #4132 - changelog / docs updates (WIP)
- Release train playbook (Confluence)

Notes to self / informal:
- Keep notes light in Drive; finalize cleaned up postmortem and changelog in Confluence before wider distribution.
- Follow up with CS on whether to offer extended support window to affected customers for the incident.

End of notes.
